description: [builtin] Deep profile of a business from its OWN website: crawls up to 5 relevant pages (menu, services, prices, hours, contact, booking) and returns a machine-readable profile — summary, hours (OSM syntax), services with prices, booking channels, payments, languages, social links. First-party data only, cached 30 days per business (force=true re-crawls). (costs $0.08 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

force.description: Re-crawl even if a fresh (≤30 days) profile is cached

name: business_details
